clips.title: The story
paras: In Bloodhoof Village, young tauren drink the sacred Water of the Seers before their tribal trials. The draught opens the mind to the spirit world and summons a Plains Vision to guide them.

Young tauren drink the Water of the Seers before the tribal fire in Bloodhoof Village. Tribal mystics prepare the draught for the ancient Rite of Vision. It opens the drinker’s spiritual sight, and the Plains Vision appears from the embers to guide the way to Seer Wiserunner.
